units.source_text: ……但是，假如我坦白出来，我人生中最初的小小的罪恶也就瓦解，

en.t: ... But if I confessed everything, the first small sin of my life would collapse as well,

units.source_text: 这种思绪制止了我，仿佛有什么东西紧紧地拽住我的后背。

en.t: and that thought stopped me, as though something were gripping my back tightly and holding me there.

units.source_text: 此时老和尚的身影已钻出了山门，在蒙蒙亮的天空下消失了。

en.t: By then, the old monk's figure had already slipped out through the temple gate and vanished beneath the dimly brightening sky.
